name: users/urls.py
summary: Django URL configuration that routes authentication endpoints to their corresponding class-based views.
purpose: Provides the routing layer for the users application, mapping HTTP URL paths to authentication view classes and enforcing separation between URL resolution logic and request handling logic.
responsibilities: Map URL paths to LoginView, LogoutView, and RegisterView
Define the urlpatterns entry point for the users Django app
Decouple URL routing from view implementation
outputs: urlpatterns list consumed by Django's URL dispatcher
Resolved view callables for matched authentication routes
architecture_notes: Acts as the routing gateway for the users app following Django's MTV architecture, specifically serving as the URL dispatcher layer. It maintains modularity by confining route definitions to the app level, allowing the project-level urls.py to include them cleanly. The use of class-based views indicates an object-oriented approach to handling authentication concerns, facilitating code reuse and mixin application.
improvements: Add app_name to enable URL namespacing and reverse URL resolution
Assign explicit name parameters to each path for maintainable reverse resolution
Consider grouping routes under an 'auth/' prefix or using include() for better modularity as the app grows
Add comments or docstrings documenting the expected request methods and payload shapes for each route
